artist.name: Eminem
artist.summary: Detroit rapper, the fastest-selling hip hop of the 2000s

suggestions.name: Royce da 5'9"
suggestions.why: Dense, technical Detroit rap; half of Bad Meets Evil with Eminem.

suggestions.name: Dr. Dre
suggestions.why: The producer behind Eminem's sound, with his own hard West Coast records.

suggestions.name: 50 Cent
suggestions.why: Hard-hitting hooks from the same label and the same years.

suggestions.name: Kendrick Lamar
suggestions.why: Story-telling rap with the same anger and wordplay.

suggestions.name: Joyner Lucas
suggestions.why: Fast, personal verses that build to a shout.

suggestions.name: Danny Brown
suggestions.why: Another Detroit voice, wilder and stranger.

suggestions.name: Tech N9ne
suggestions.why: Rapid-fire independent rap from Kansas City.

suggestions.name: Atmosphere
suggestions.why: Confessional Minneapolis rap, quieter but as honest.

suggestions.name: Brother Ali
suggestions.why: Soulful, outspoken rap from the same Minneapolis label.

suggestions.name: Dido
suggestions.bridge: Eminem built Stan on a sample of her song Thank You, and she sings its hook.

suggestions.name: Aerosmith
suggestions.bridge: Eminem's Sing for the Moment is built on their Dream On, guitar solo and all.

suggestions.name: Elton John
suggestions.bridge: He sang Stan with Eminem at the 2001 Grammys, piano and all.
